zh.title: 海豚颱風逼近日本 下令疏散並取消500個航班
zh.summary: 根據路透社報導，隨著海豚颱風逼近，日本當局已發布疏散命令，並已取消500個航班。為因應颱風帶來的威脅，相關部門與交通單位實施預防性應變措施，維護民眾與旅客安全。氣象與航空相關動態仍持續受到關注與評估。
body: 隨著海豚颱風持續逼近日本，當地政府已發布疏散命令，並同步取消500個航班。此項防颱措施旨於因應惡劣天候威脅，維護民眾與旅客的安全。
路透社報導指出，海豚颱風的逼近促使當地政府與交通部門採取預防應變措施。大量航班的取消對區域空中運輸造成影響，相關單位已啟動預防性疏散計畫。
針對海豚颱風帶來的潛在影響，當局提醒相關區域民眾注意安全避難。同時航空業者與交通單位將持續監控氣象動態，並根據天候狀況評估營運與交通恢復情形。

en.title: Japan Orders Evacuations and Cancels 500 Flights as Typhoon Dolphin Approaches
en.summary: According to reports from Reuters, Japan has issued evacuation orders while preparing for the arrival of Typhoon Dolphin. In addition to the official evacuation directives, a total of 500 flights have been cancelled as the typhoon approaches. The severe weather disruption has impacted air travel operations across the affected regions, leading authorities and transportation providers to take precautionary measures. Further operational adjustments remain tied to the progression of Typhoon Dolphin as officials monitor the storm's impact on public safety and transport infrastructure.
body: As Typhoon Dolphin approaches Japan, authorities have ordered evacuations and cancelled 500 flights to ensure public safety and manage severe weather risks. The administrative orders and widespread flight cancellations were initiated as the storm moved closer to the region.

According to reports from Reuters, the cancellation of 500 flights reflects significant operational disruptions across air transportation services. Local emergency management agencies have advised residents in affected areas to follow evacuation instructions while preparations continue.

Aviation operators and local transport authorities remain focused on monitoring weather conditions as Typhoon Dolphin progresses, with flight schedules subject to further adjustment based on safety developments.

zh.title: 美國航空使用電氣化永續航空燃料完成商業航班飛行
zh.summary: 美國航空已使用電氣化永續航空燃料（eSAF），完成自科珀斯克里斯蒂國際機場（CRP）至達拉斯-沃斯堡國際機場（DFW）的航班飛行。該燃料由 Infinium 位於德州的 Pathfinder 設施生產與混合，為美國商業機場首度接收非生物基原料 SAF。美國航空並已就 Project Roadrunner 簽署商業採購協議。
body: 美國航空已使用電氣化永續航空燃料（eSAF），完成自德克薩斯州科珀斯克里斯蒂國際機場飛往達拉斯-沃斯堡國際機場的商業客運航班。此項飛行展示了電力轉液體合成燃料能夠直接整合至現有機場燃料供應系統中，且無需進行特殊的處理或設備修改。
本次航班所使用的 eSAF 燃料，是由 Infinium 位於德州科珀斯克里斯蒂的 Pathfinder 設施進行生產與混合。該設施為全球首座商業規模的電力轉液體燃料生產基地。該燃料與傳統噴射燃料進行混合後，通過測試符合 ASTM International 之 JetA 規格標準，這也是美國商業機場首次接收由非生物基原料所製成的永續航空燃料。
美國航空執行長 Robert Isom 對此表示，該航班展現了次世代技術如何從早期投資走向實際應用，而擴大生產規模並降低價格對於減少排放及提升長期競爭力至關重要。Infinium 執行長 Robert Schuetzle 則指出，自 2023 年以來該公司已生產可用於商業卡車的電力柴油與電力石腦油，將 eSAF 納入產品線並為商業航班提供動力，是推動低碳燃料解決方案的重大進展。
此外，美國航空已與 Infinium 的 Project Roadrunner 簽署商業規模 eSAF 的採購協議。該設施目前正在興建中，預計將於明年開始生產與交付 eSAF，達到全產能後每年可生產超過 500 萬加侖。根據國際航空運輸協會（IATA）最新數據，目前全球營運中與興建中的 eSAF 產能僅約 0.02 百萬噸，全球亦僅有一處生產基地正在營運。

en.title: American Airlines Operates Commercial Flight Using Electro-Sustainable Aviation Fuel
en.summary: American Airlines has completed a commercial passenger flight from Corpus Christi International Airport (CRP) to Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) using electro-sustainable aviation fuel (eSAF). The fuel was produced and blended at Infinium's Pathfinder facility in Corpus Christi, Texas, representing the first delivery of non-biobased SAF to a commercial US airport. The eSAF was blended with conventional jet fuel and tested under ASTM International specification JetA standards. American Airlines has also established an offtake agreement for commercial eSAF volumes from Infinium's Project Roadrunner facility currently under construction.
body: American Airlines has operated a commercial passenger flight from Corpus Christi International Airport (CRP)  to Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW)  using electro-sustainable aviation fuel (eSAF). The flight demonstrated that power-to-liquid eSAF can be integrated directly into regular airport fuel supply infrastructure without requiring any special handling procedures.

The eSAF utilized on the flight was part of a batch produced and blended at Infinium’s Pathfinder facility in Corpus Christi, Texas, the world’s first commercial-scale power-to-liquids eFuels production site. Blended with conventional jet fuel and tested to meet ASTM International specifications for JetA, the flight marked the first delivery of sustainable aviation fuel from non-biobased feedstocks to a commercial airport in the United States. eSAF offers lifecycle greenhouse gas emission reductions of over 90 percent compared to standard petroleum jet fuel.

Chief Executive Officer Robert Isom stated that through the partnership with Infinium, American Airlines is demonstrating how next-generation technologies like eSAF can move from early investment to real-world application. Infinium Chief Executive Officer Robert Schuetzle noted that the company has produced drop-in eDiesel and eNaphtha at its Pathfinder facility since 2023, and adding eSAF to power a commercial passenger flight represents a meaningful step forward in low-carbon fuel solutions.

American Airlines holds an offtake agreement for commercial volumes of eSAF from Infinium’s Project Roadrunner. Project Roadrunner is currently under construction and expected to begin eSAF production and deliveries next year, with an estimated full capacity exceeding 5 million gallons annually. Figures from the International Air Transport Association (IATA) indicate that global operating and under-construction eSAF capacity totals approximately 0.02 million tonnes, with only one operational production site.
